description: NPM ERESOLVE conflict between ondajs and remotion due to conflicting zod versions, preventing clean `npm ci`.
remediation: Aligned workspace root zod to ^3.25.0 and synchronized all @remotion/* packages to 4.0.524, allowing valid nested installations.

description: Blueprint defined raw physical paths (sometimes pointing to agent-specific directories or developer-local paths) which break cross-environment portability.
remediation: Enforced Logical Asset IDs in blueprint. materialize_project.py generates media_map.json. Runtime safely resolves logical IDs to relative paths.

description: 04_timings.json, master_plan.md, and 05_blueprint.json lack a unified pipeline-invoked automation script. The canonical producer is the Agent interacting with MCPs and manually generating intermediate JSONs.
remediation: Documented the explicit pipeline boundary. The Agent is formally recognized as the orchestrating producer of these files, while the Python pipeline acts strictly as a mechanical validator/gatekeeper.

description: Missing pytest-asyncio in requirements.txt caused async test suites in fresh venv to execute as sync, causing 15 test failures.
remediation: Added pytest-asyncio to requirements.txt in main repository.

description: scripts/pipeline.py lacked an execution step for scripts/generators/materialize_project.py, leaving media_map.json ungenerated and public assets unmaterialized during pipeline execution.
remediation: Added materialize_project execution stage to scripts/pipeline.py under Blueprint/Asset transition.

description: scripts/generators/materialize_project.py hardcoded check for 01_plan.md instead of supporting canonical master_plan.md.
remediation: Updated materialize_project.py to accept either master_plan.md or legacy 01_plan.md.

description: scripts/render_project.py blocked rendering if status != 'locked' even when running under managed canonical pipeline (is_managed == True), preventing headless execution without manual gate approval bypasses.
remediation: Allowed managed pipeline execution (is_managed == True) to render without requiring manual GUI gate approval.

description: scripts/gates/probe_qc.py and scripts/open_studio.py generated render_props.json without including media_map, causing QC frame rendering and Studio preview to fail asset resolution for Logical Asset IDs.
remediation: Included media_map: safe_load('media_map.json', {}) in projectData for both scripts/gates/probe_qc.py and scripts/open_studio.py.

description: scripts/gates/asset_gate.py expected a direct manifest path argument, while scripts/pipeline.py passes project_id, causing asset_gate to skip manifest validation during canonical pipeline execution.
remediation: Updated asset_gate.py to resolve project_id or project directory to 02_asset_manifest.json.

description: scripts/security/security.py did not include scripts/generators/materialize_project.py in ALLOWED_SCRIPTS['python'], causing safe_subprocess to block materialize_project during Phase 3 canonical pipeline execution.
remediation: Added scripts/generators/materialize_project.py to ALLOWED_SCRIPTS['python'] in scripts/security/security.py.

description: Herodeviceassemblewrapper accepted upstream by ground truth and pipeline validators, but getRegistryEntry('Herodeviceassemblewrapper') returned undefined during Remotion rendering due to drift between ground truth names, component stems, and TEMPLATE_REGISTRY keys.
remediation: Established deterministic derivation of 210 runtime aliases from authoritative metadata (scripts/generators/generate_template_aliases.py -> registry/template-aliases.ts) and wrapped TEMPLATE_REGISTRY in a transparent Proxy in registry/template-registry.tsx. All 105 active production templates resolve by canonical ID, ground-truth title-case name, and PascalCase component stem without polluting Object.values(). Enforced by permanent consistency tests in pytest (tests/test_template_registry_consistency.py) and Vitest (tests/template_runtime_resolution.test.ts), verified with 5/5 Remotion renderStill smoke tests.

category: Deferred Runtime Prop Contract / Temporal Render Coverage
description: Deferred Runtime Prop Contract / Temporal Render Coverage: Datastorywrapper rendered successfully initially, then crashed when AnimatedBarChart mounted and received undefined data (TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined reading 'slice').
failure: Datastorywrapper rendered successfully initially, then crashed when AnimatedBarChart mounted and received undefined data.
remediation: Restored exact canonical historical defaults from commit 9dcb888b (Root.tsx) directly inside remotion-app/src/compositions/data-story/index.tsx (DEFAULT_BAR_DATA, DEFAULT_METRICS, DEFAULT_STEPS) using nullish coalescing (??) to preserve explicit empty collections ([]). Added fail-closed runtime Zod validation in DataStory and Python gate validation in scripts/gates/code_template_gate.py rejecting malformed inputs (strings, objects, nulls) while strictly preserving required contracts for child primitives (AnimatedBarChartProps.data, MetricTickerProps.metrics, TimelineStepsProps.steps). Added permanent Vitest and Pytest contract suites, and verified 14/14 multi-frame temporal runtime smoke renders across all Clean-Room scenario templates.
